headline: A 2002 executive order created a federal Corporate Fraud Task Force.
what_it_does: This order set up a government task force focused on corporate fraud. Based on the title alone, its purpose was to organize the federal government's work against fraud by companies. No summary was provided, so details about the task force's members, powers, and duties are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that investigate or prosecute business crimes
who_it_affects.how: They were brought together under a new task force focused on corporate fraud.
They became the focus of a federal effort aimed at fraud by companies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 9, 2002; the material provided gives no separate start date.
